data.narrative:
Viken Detection is a Series C-stage frontier-tech company in the Defense & Security sector, having raised $50M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 12 same-sector peers at similar or adjacent stages, comprising 8 private and 2 public companies. Key private comparables include Quantum-Systems ($8.0B, Series C), Helsing ($18.0B, Series D), and Saronic ($9.2B, Series D); public peers trade on DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical Series C to next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.7x to the $50M total raised proxy, yielding $85M. Peer-median analysis across the 12-company comparable set produces $1.8B, reflecting a wide range of $300M to $18.0B driven by heterogeneity in maturity and market position within frontier defense tech. The stage-progression method assumes minimal growth between fundraise and valuation date, while the peer approach captures market-driven pricing for operational companies at comparable stages.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $72M to $2.0B, with a median of $930M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around revenue scale, technology differentiation, and customer concentration—typical for pre-exit frontier-defense players. Narrowing the range would require clarity on Viken's revenue run-rate and customer base relative to the peer set.
